verses.text: Oh, if only you would tear open the heavens and come down, so that the mountains would shake before you,
like fire that sets twigs burning and makes water boil! Come down to make your name known to your enemies, so that the nations will tremble before you!
Long ago you did amazing things we did not expect. You came down, and the mountains shook before you.
Since the world began, no one has heard, no ear has noticed, and no eye has seen any God besides you, who acts on behalf of those who wait for him.
You come to help those who gladly do what is right, who remember your ways. But look, you were angry because we kept on sinning. We have been sinning for so long. How can we be saved?
All of us have become like someone who is unclean. All our good deeds are like dirty rags. We all wither like leaves, and our sins sweep us away like the wind.
No one calls on your name or makes an effort to hold on to you. For you have hidden your face from us and let us waste away because of our sins.
Yet, LORD, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you are the potter. We are all the work of your hand.
Do not be so very angry, LORD. Do not remember our sins forever. Please, look at us. We are all your people.
Your holy cities have become a wilderness. Zion has become a wilderness, and Jerusalem a ruin.
Our holy and beautiful temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire. All the places we treasured are in ruins.
After all this, LORD, will you still hold back? Will you stay silent and punish us so severely?
